title: Delivery
description: §6.5's Delivery — {envelope, opened: bool, payload?, reason?, returnReceipt?}. It lives here and not in spec/schemas/ because §18.5 fixes the fourteen files there by name and Delivery is not among them: §6.5 defines it in prose, as the shape inbox returns, and adding a fifteenth file would be a specification change (§1.7). Reported as a divergence with the Step 3 record.

payload.description: Present exactly when opened is true.

reason.description: §6.5's reasons on an unopened delivery. None of these is a failure of the tool (P-12).
